r120.pv: Dr asks the child patient's behaviour to his parents, his parents tell the doctor that he often makes weird activities to laugh or make people around him laugh
r120.pv2: A Psychiatric patient may do such activities and the physician will observe and find it funny and this rubric can thus be considered.
r120.wu: It is purely an observational rubric. observation by the physician or patient's relatives . Example - A child comes in clinic but behaves weirdly - makes faces, shouts, howls ..laughs , makes people around laugh.

r121.m: Anxiety is a feeling of fear , uneasiness ,nervousness about the outcome of the situation which the person currently is in.
r121.pv: I usually feel anxious and nervous all the time about many things of my life.
r121.wu: A Constant assertion by the patient about the feeling of fear or nervousness for the outcome of his situation can guide you to the choice of this rubric. Although, It will rarely be told by patient that he is anxious, it should be the physician's observation to notice this anxious nature of the patient and record the rubric for analysis. It can be one of the commonest rubrics taken by physicians for analysis.

r331.m: Aphasia is a disorder that affects how you communicate. It may be due to damage to some portion of the brain.
r331.wu: This rubric can be taken in cases where aphasia is observed due to pathological condition that affects the brain areas responsible for language. conditions like - stroke, traumatic conditions to brain, brain tumors, brain infections, etc can be few diseases that cause aphasia.

r333.m: A person who is very passionate and enthusiastic about a topic he likes to discuss with everyone or research about it to discover the nitty gritty things of it or just for the love of that topic.
r333.pv: I m an ardent fan of cricket
r333.wu: Whenever a person passionately shares a topic or tells about it in details , This rubric can be taken.

r335.m: To Ask means to address someone to gather information. Nothing means not anything . Here it would mean that person asks for nothing - no food,no water, no desires , etc.
r335.pv: The Relatives may complain that the patient is getting weaker and weaker by the disease and he does not express any desire to have food/water or any other thing.
r335.wu: In Acute or chronic cases, patients will be consumed by the disease process and not ask for any food, water or even basic needs by themselves. in Such a situation, this rubric can be taken.

r337.m: Attitude is a settled way or thinking or behaving. strange - something that is not unusual.
r337.wu: The person will assume vague posture in sitting or sleep. It can be an observational rubric or subjective symptom shared by patient or his relatives (especially about sleep position )

r338.m: A willingness to take bold risks is audacity.
r338.pv: Without seeing the height of the bed or sofa my child jumps rightaway
r338.pv2: i invested in share market without studying the pros and cons of that specific stock and thus i think i suffered.
r338.wu: The Patient will describe a life situation in which he or she has taken a bold step without realising the pros and cons

r340.m: Extreme Greed for material wealth is avarice
r340.wu: Most of the patients will tell that they dont spend much and keep on saving money,they can be avarice.Other aspect to this can be that the patients who are having greed for having too many things ( wealth, excess workout ,etc) can be termed as avarice too.

r341.m: Approach means to come nearer. Aversion means to avoid.
r341.pv: Whenever anyone walks from near me, i just try to withdraw my leg since there can be a chance that they can hurt me.
r341.pv2: The Patient avoids the approach of any other person either due to his physical problem or due to his pre conceived beliefs impacting him psychologically.
r341.wu: There will be a direct mention by the patient about him avoiding the people around due to reasons which affect him.

r342.m: Aversion means to avoid.Everything here means -all things in patients surrounding and life.
r342.pv: I do not want anyone around me since the last few days.
r342.wu: The Patient will claim that he has developed an aversion to everything around him.

r343.m: Aversion means to avoid. Friend here means -anyone with whom the patient has developed an affection in his life.
r343.pv: I do not wish to meet my friends these days due to some quarrel between us.
r343.wu: The Patient will claim himself that he does not wish to be around his friends due to some reason. If not directly, then indirectly, He may hint subtly in case taking as well that he is averse to his friends since a certain duration of time.

r344.m: Aversion means to avoid. Friend here means -anyone with whom the patient has developed an affection in his life. Pregnancy is the state of conception and having an embryo growing in the female uterus. Some Metaphorical understanding may lead to deciphering pregnancy as a state of being conceptualised with some idea or thought.
r344.pv: I am not talking to my friends in my current pregnancy
r344.wu: The Patient will claim himself that he does not wish to be around his friends due to some reason. If not directly, then indirectly, He may hint subtly in case taking as well that he is averse to his friends since her pregnancy.

r345.m: Aversion means to avoid. Husband here means a man who is considered as a spouse or someone who is king of the house or someone who can be of economic benefit.
r345.pv: Since the time of Quarrel i am staying away from my husband
r345.wu: The Patient will have strong feelings of aversion to her husband or the one whom she depends upon financially. It will either be directly told by the patient about her aversion or the physician will understand from the life situation of the patient where she mentions about it.

r347.m: Aversion means to avoid. Family means group of one or more members or parents living as one unit together.
r347.pv: ever since i had a quarrel with my brother ,i have stopped talking to him
r347.pv2: I do not talk to my sister since the time she spoiled my image in front of my own family

r348.m: Aversion means to avoid. Certain is used here when the patient is mentioning about someone not known to the physician
r348.pv: I do not want to think or talk about that person who has spoiled my relations with me due to unnecessary quarrel.
r348.pv2: Everytime whenever i Have a quarrel with anyone. i wish to avoid that person for many weeks.
r348.wu: Patients will tell you that they have reservations against certain people and that should give a good idea to the physician to pick up this rubric.

r349.t: AVERSION, religious, to the opposite sex
r349.m: Aversion means to avoid. Religious means believing in workship of god. opposite sex - will mean person of the opposite gender.
r349.pv: I normally dont interact with ladies of that community

r351.m: Aversion means to avoid.Those around here means anyone around him
r351.pv: since the time my father is ill, he just does not want anyone around him

r352.pv: Dr, Since the time i heard the news of the fire in the next building, i m not feeling good
r352.pv2: I heard the news on the Media channels about a massive fight broke out between two groups of people in our society since that time i m not feeling good. [When to Use This Rubric -Any news that is imparting a negative feeling to the patient or to a section of public in general - are the cases where we can use this rubric.

r353.m: Barking here means to utter (a word or some words) abruptly or aggressively
r353.wu: A Behaviour that indicates that the patient is answering abruptly , aggresively is where we can use this rubric in repertorisation. it may be found in brain troubles. It can be more of an observational rubric rather than a direct actual expression by the patient

r355.m: Battles means fight between opposing forces.
r355.pv: I am not happy with the lawsuit going on in a recent dispute between my brothers.
r355.pv2: since the time of divorce this problem is happening.
r355.wu: The patient is bothered about a legal battle or a unwanted dispute in his family or someone around his life... So its not always a real battle which will be the case.

r357.m: Bed is a place which is used for resting or sleeping. desire is a strong feeling of wanting something. remain in means to stay where you are considering the present position.
r357.pv: Once my son is down with fever, he cannot get up for 2 days. we need to feed him constantly in bed.
r357.pv2: My father who is 60 yr old, will not move a inch when he is ill.he will keep himself on the bed and get his demands fulfilled in illness.
r357.wu: Many times patients will make it a behaviour to remain in bed to overcome the illness phase but if it is extended far more than what a normal illness rest period should look like, this rubric can be taken. it can also be an objective sign from the patient's relatives.

r358.t: BED, jumps out of, wants to destroy himself but lacks courage
r358.m: Bed is a place which is used for resting or sleeping. Jumps out of = here means he wants to get out of the position he is in. courage is the ability to confront fear,pain,danger and taking action depsite uncertain situations.
r358.pv: I want to change my job but i cannot change it due to many reasons.
r358.pv2: A Gym is newly opened in our building and i can go but i just cannot find the time to get up early and then i m busy through the whole day to go there.
r358.wu: Any comfort zone of the patient which makes him feel far more comfortablethan the illness permitting and also the statement also shows that the patient lacks the courage to get out of his comfort zone , calls for the use of this rubric.

r360.m: Begging is act of asking for something as a charity especially when the person asking is needy. Entreat means to urgently ask someone to do something here it is begging, it is more of a sincere request.
r360.pv: can u please please please relieve me of gastric trouble at the earliest.
r360.wu: In the talk with the patient you will notice that there is a fervent request from the patient to get cured at the earliest or the relative will tell you that the paitent keeps making a request at home for certain thing.. this should give you a clue to using this rubric.

r361.m: Begging is act of asking for something as a charity especially when the person asking is needy. Entreat means to urgently ask someone to do something here it is begging, it is more of a sincere request. sleep is a natural state of rest for the body and mind
r361.wu: in certain deliriums or fevers the patient may ask for something as a request. this is where you can pick up this rubric

r362.m: Bellow means to shout or roar loudly often in a deep voice. bellow can produce a strong force of air
r362.wu: Bellowing can be a voice produced by the patient in certain conditions of the mind or his tone may reflect the bellowing as seen in the meaning of the word

r364.m: a kind,charitable, well meaning person is a benevolent person and the act is an act of benevolence.
r364.pv: i always help all the poor people who are in the slum areas. i give them food and all essentials
r364.pv2: i was going by the traffic signal and these small boys come with some little things to buy...i always buy stuff from them
r364.wu: All acts in patient's behaviour will point to a kind behavior as explained in the meaning and you can take this rubric

r367.m: Biting means to use teeth to cut using it as grip.
r367.pv: my 3 yr old child always keeps biting everyone at home
r367.pv2: His words are always laced with sharp criticism and very hurtful
r367.wu: Either in Actions or words if the patient's act or words indicate the meaning we have described then this rubric can be thought

r368.m: Biting means to use teeth to cut using it as grip. night either means the dark period of the 24 hrs or the time when disease is in ending phase

r4404.t: BLACK and sombre, everything that is, aversion to
r4404.m: Black as a colour is darkest and symbolizes mystery,fear mourning, sombre meaning something that is sad or serious or lack of light. aversion means - the person wants to avoid it.
r4404.pv: I generally avoid going to funerals as the mysterious atmosphere makes me emotionally disturbed
r4404.wu: The patient will claim certain situations or events that affect him which are mysterious or evoke a fear or sad feeling in him. if that is the case persistently at many events in life of the patient then this rubric can be thought to be taken for analysis.

r376.m: Blindness means lacking visual perception due to physiological or neurological reasons. pretending means to act as if something is true when it is not. it involves a false appearance.
r376.wu: Some patients will give a false presentation of what they see things and their relatives will confirm this to you in a separate sitting about this phenomenon and then you can confirm the choice of this rubric. interestingly the remedy is veratrum which is known to produce a fake appearance of many things to achieve a social status.

r377.t: BLOOD, cannot look at, or a knife
r377.m: Blood is the vital fluid in the human body which perform essential functions. Knife is a sharp object used to cut or stab. cannot look at means unable or unwilling to observe something.

r379.m: Break means to separate something into pieces. Thing means any object. desire to - means a strong feeling of wish or wanting for something.
r379.pv: My son always breaks all the toys that we bring for him.
r379.pv2: When i get angry, i have this desire to break things immediately...this resolves my anger issues. [When to Use This Rubric -the patient or his relatives will convey that he has a habit of breaking things all the time.

r380.m: Brooding Means to be in a state of deep and serious reflective thought often with a serious or troubled demeanour
r380.pv: Every evening after i leave my office and come home,i sit for one hour by the window and think if i made the right decision to leave the previous company.
r380.pv2: Since thetime my friend has shouted on me, i have constantly thought over that issue everyday [When to Use This Rubric -This rubric can be used when the story or life situaion of the patient points to one issue in his life which he is persistently thinking or grieving upon. Compare with dwells on past disagreeable occurences

r383.m: Business means engaging in production,buying selling of goods services to generate profit. It also refers to one's occupation or trade.
r383.wu: All Communication related to business will be interspersed in the communication by patient about his complaints. hence the physician needs to be a good observer about the talk to notice these words and record this rubric.
r383.pv: I dont go for business on certain days as it is inauspicious
r383.pv2: I do not want to go to work on days when i m not keeping fine. [When to Use This Rubric -While describing his complaints, patient may speak a bit or at length about how he is avoiding his business or not working on it due to illness or any other reason. if you are all listen his expression carefully then it is possible to know this version of patient and take into analysis

r384.m: Business means engaging in production,buying selling of goods services to generate profit. It also refers to one's occupation or trade. incapacity means he does not have the capacity or energy to do the work. It is the inability to do any physical,mental or legal inability to perform the work or business.
r384.wu: Due to illness the person is not able to focus on business or shares some other concern that he cannot attend to his business. in such cases this rubric can be taken.

r385.m: Business means engaging in production,buying selling of goods services to generate profit. It also refers to one's occupation or trade. "talks of" means certain topic or subject that is being discussed.
r385.pv: Dr do something about this cough , my business is affected , i need to talk all the time so this cough is bothering me a lot
r385.pv2: I need to rush to another city for a meeting tomorrow itself. can u cure my fever soon ?
r385.wu: The patient will communicate about his complaints but additionally he will also keep talking about his business and how it is affected due to his illness.

r386.m: busy generally means having to do a lot of being engaged in various activities or tasks or work.
r386.pv: My wife is always doing one household chore or the other.
r386.pv2: when i go to office i do not rest for a minute but take up one or the other work immediately so that i can finish all work soon.
r386.wu: Patients will share one or the other ways in which they are always busy in their work or routines. in such cases this rubric can be taken.

r387.m: Busy generally means having to do a lot of being engaged in various activities or tasks or work. fruitlessly means without any purpose or aim to do the work.
r387.pv: Even if the work is over, My Mil keeps on doing some or the other work and does not sit silently
r387.pv2: all day and night my son keeps on playing with one or the other toy.
r387.wu: Any activity conveyed by patient or told by his relative that shows his nature of being busy without the actual need to be busy is an indication to record this rubric

r390.m: capricious is someone that is sudden,unpredictable in mood or behaviour.
r390.pv: my child's mood changes suddenly from happy to angry in few minutes.
r390.pv2: when my friends fight with me, i snappishly cut of my relation with them and dont talk for days. at once moment i was happy but immediately i become sad and weepy... [When to Use This Rubric -a child may change mood quickly from happy to sad or weepy or anger whereas a teenager or an adult will show traits that he or she takes decisions impulsively or change their minds suddenly.

r393.m: Carefullness means taking caution and paying close attention to avoid potential harm or mistakes or unwanted outcomes.
r393.pv: I take utmost care in maintaining my health
r393.pv2: I take my child's health very seriously when we go out of town.
r393.wu: Carefullness may show an emotion which denotes a persons attentiveness conscientious in actions or decisions. it is a very close rubric to cautious. differentiate between words and actions denoting those words of the patient to take the correct rubric

r395.m: Care means doing something to protect the person or thing/relation/emotion or it can be the process of providing someone with something thing that he/she needs.
r395.pv: When anyone in my family is ill, i m so worried i go to all extent -by doing things for him/her to help them recover well.
r395.pv2: Our 5 yr old will take care of his grandmother when she is ill.
r395.wu: Any action by the patient which shows care for anyone ill or healthy calls for taking this rubric into consideration.

r396.m: Care means doing something to protect the person or thing/relation/emotion or it can be the process of providing someone with something thing that he/she needs.Ailment from means the origin or cause of a condition.
r396.pv: My complaints started after i was worried for my fathers ill health..i had to stay awake for long hours and also there was no nurse available
r396.pv2: My son was ill for 3 months and there was no diagnosis by drs we had to stay awake day and night to monitor him.since that time i developed my complaints.
r396.wu: In most cases of illness in the family or some untoward incident in the family - like a financial loss or grief ,some patients are affected emotionally. if the meaning and patient version fits this condition, you can choose this rubric for analysis.

r397.m: Care means doing something to protect the person or thing/relation/emotion or it can be the process of providing someone with something thing that he/she needs.domestic means related to home or family or within a country. affairs mean matters of concern or interest that are important or concerning.
r397.pv: i m very sensitive about any quarrels happening between my brother in law and sister. i try to console and counsel them if it happens.

r400.m: Carried means to support or lift the person emotionally,physically or by any act that helps him feel good. desire is the want expressed by the patient
r400.pv: My child always wants me to carry him when he starts with bout of cough or fever
r400.pv2: My mom wants me to stay beside her and console her when she has any Migraine issue, she may want me to talk or rub or head or do anything which calms her down
r400.wu: The patient will tell that the physician is his only hope and he is handing over his health to the physician till he gets well he will just take treatment from the physician and no one else.

r402.m: Carried means to support or lift the person emotionally,physically or by any act that helps him feel good. desire is the want expressed by the patient. Fast here means as quickly as one can carry the complainer
r402.pv: As soon as my daughter gets a cold or cough she wants me to carry her and keep her in arms for day long
r402.pv2: My Grandfather always wants to be treated immediately as he gets a cold bout
r402.wu: the patient will tell you that dr i have visited so many drs but got no result. someone suggested me to come to you. i have come. now you are only in charge of my treatment. i expect you to give me relief at the earliest since my suffering is too unbearable.

r401.t: CARRIED, desires to be, in croup
r401.m: Carried means to support or lift the person emotionally,physically or by any act that helps him feel good. desire is the want expressed by the patient. Croup is a type of respiratory infection especially in children having symptoms like barking,difficulty in breathing
r401.pv: My child always wants me to carry him when he starts with bout of cough and difficulty in breathing
r401.pv2: Whenever my child has difficulty in breathing or cough symptoms he wants only me to carry him.he will not stay alone or be on the ground or in bed
r401.wu: Metaphorically a person having a grave illness can ask for close help and company and thus it can imply carried feeling

r403.m: Carried means to support or lift the person emotionally,physically or by any act that helps him feel good. desire is the want expressed by the patient. slow here means with a reduced pace or taking more time than normal as one can carry the complainer
r403.pv: My daughter always wants to be carried slowly when she has fever
